projects.title: JFS SuperApp • Little Nest

Owned and scaled the UPI payments vertical — drove NPCI compliance certification, multi-bank API integration, and real-time monitoring → scaled volume to 180K average daily transactions at 99%+ uptime with 85%+ successful payment processing.

Defined the Consent Management compliance vertical — authored RBI-compliant AA data-sharing specifications and drove fintech vendor integration → delivered consolidated financial views to thousands of users monthly.

Drove the analytics platform implementation (Google Analytics + internal dashboards) — defined KPI frameworks tracking transaction volume, adoption, and drop-off rates → drove double-digit improvements in key engagement metrics.

Led key product initiatives for the AI-powered financial marketplace (FDs, loans, credit cards, gold) — defined product requirements and led third-party lender API integration → generated ~20% cross-sell revenue uplift post-launch.

Improved product delivery efficiency through backlog refinement and sprint planning across multiple enterprise tracks — improved requirement clarity and feasibility → reduced development rework by ~20% while keeping delivery tightly aligned to business goals.

deepDives.upi:
UPI Payments Scalability


Context

JFS needed a highly scalable UPI payments vertical to handle massive daily transaction volumes.


Constraint

Strict adherence to NPCI compliance, multi-bank API disparities, and demanding uptime requirements.


Decision

Implemented a unified API integration strategy with robust fallback mechanisms to ensure high availability.


Metric Impact

Scaled to 180K average daily transactions, maintaining 99%+ uptime and an 85%+ successful processing rate.


What I Owned

End-to-end UPI roadmap, NPCI certification, API integration, and real-time monitoring rollout.
deepDives.chatbot:
Agentic Chatbot for JFS


Context

Users needed a seamless, conversational interface within the JFS SuperApp to navigate complex financial services.


Constraint

Integrating sophisticated AI/GenAI models while ensuring financial data privacy and minimizing hallucination risks.


Decision

Adopted an agentic workflow architecture that tightly controls AI actions within secure bounds.


Metric Impact

Successfully scaled usage to 65,000 daily prompts, significantly driving conversational engagement.


What I Owned

The Agentic Chatbot product lifecycle, iterative roadmap execution, and executive stakeholder alignment.
deepDives.littlenest:
Little Nest Club Management Platform


Context

Operations required a centralized system for class creation, slot management, bookings, and administration.


Constraint

Legacy workflows were deeply entrenched; the new platform had to be intuitive enough to require zero training.


Decision

Focused on a unified mobile+web approach, prioritizing the instructor and admin dashboards first.


Metric Impact

Streamlined booking journeys and reduced operational overhead by centralizing fragmented tools.


What I Owned

Requirement shaping, stakeholder coordination, launch planning, and post-release iteration.
